newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian parliament approves Norilsk aid proposals.
newsitem.headline: Russian parliament approves Norilsk aid proposals.

text.p: Russia's State Duma lower parliament house approved on Wednesday recommendations that the government support the financially-troubled Norilsk Nickel metals group and extend its control over shares.
The Duma approved the recommendation, which is not legally binding, by 309 votes for the proposal to three against and two abstentions.
The Duma will send the recommendation to the government. It does not need approval from the upper house.
The Duma proposals include blocking restructuring plans by commercial bank Uneximbank, which has a 38 percent stake in RAO Norilsky Nickel 0#NKEL.RUO, or 51 percent of voting shares.
The proposals also urge the government to have until 2000 government control over the Norilsk stake now owned by Uneximbank, which acquired the equity in a shares-for-loans auction in 1995.
